relations.name: invoice_billed_name
relations.meaning: The billed counterparty name on an invoice as it appears in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground invoice referent and billed_name value to sources/billing/invoices.json row field billed_name.
relations.construction_rule: C1: For each invoice object in invoices.json, assert one tuple binding invoice referent billing:invoice:<invoice_id> to the literal billed_name string.

relations.name: invoice_amount
relations.meaning: The billed amount on an invoice as represented in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to the amount field on the matching invoices.json row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse amount as REAL from each invoice record.

relations.name: invoice_currency
relations.meaning: The currency code on an invoice as represented in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to the currency field on the matching invoices.json row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Copy currency string from each invoice record.

relations.name: invoice_period
relations.meaning: The billing period label on an invoice as represented in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to the period field on the matching invoices.json row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Copy period string from each invoice record.

relations.name: invoice_status
relations.meaning: The payment status on an invoice (e.g. open, paid) as represented in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to the status field on the matching invoices.json row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Copy status string from each invoice record.

relations.name: invoice_tax_id
relations.meaning: The VAT or tax identifier on an invoice when present in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to vat_or_tax_id on the matching invoices.json row; omit tuple when field is empty.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Copy non-empty vat_or_tax_id from each invoice record.

relations.name: crm_account_name
relations.meaning: The account name on a CRM record as it appears in crm.csv.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground account referent crm:<crm_account_id> and name to crm.csv account_name column.
relations.construction_rule: C1: One tuple per CRM row.

relations.name: crm_account_status
relations.meaning: The lifecycle status on a CRM account as represented in crm.csv.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to the status column on the matching crm.csv row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: One tuple per CRM row.

relations.name: registry_legal_name
relations.meaning: The registered legal name of a company as it appears in company_registry.csv.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground company referent registry:<company_number> and legal_name to registry CSV row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: One tuple per registry row.

relations.name: registry_jurisdiction
relations.meaning: The jurisdiction of a registered company as stated in company_registry.csv.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to the jurisdiction column on the matching registry row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: One tuple per registry row.

relations.name: registry_company_status
relations.meaning: The registry filing status (e.g. active, dissolved) as stated in company_registry.csv.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to the status column on the matching registry row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: One tuple per registry row.

relations.name: contract_identifier
relations.meaning: The contract identifier derived from the contract source filename without extension.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground contract referent contract:<basename> and contract_id to sources/contracts/<basename>.md.
relations.construction_rule: C1: For each contract markdown file, contract_id equals filename stem (e.g. MSA-HELION-2019).

relations.name: contract_counterparty_name
relations.meaning: The counterparty name stated in a contract document header as it appears in the source text.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to the Counterparty line in the contract markdown file.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse the Counterparty field from each contract file header.

relations.name: contract_effective_date
relations.meaning: The effective date of a contract as stated in the contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to the Effective line in the contract markdown file.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse Effective date text from each contract file header.

relations.name: contract_expiry_date
relations.meaning: An explicit expiry date stated in a contract document when the source text provides one.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to an explicit Expiry or equivalent date line in contract text; omit when no expiry is stated.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse Expiry date when present (e.g. SOW-VEL-2022); do not infer expiry from term language alone.

relations.name: contract_term_clause
relations.meaning: The term or duration clause text from a contract header as it appears in the source.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground to the Term line in the contract markdown file.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Copy Term field text from each contract file header.

relations.name: contract_section_clause
relations.meaning: The verbatim text of a numbered contract section extracted from a contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground section_label and clause_text to the corresponding heading and body in the contract markdown file.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Split contract body on markdown section headings; one tuple per section with label and full section text.

relations.name: commercial_note_entry
relations.meaning: A discrete factual assertion recorded in sources/commercial_notes.md as an internal note paragraph.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must ground note_text to the corresponding paragraph in commercial_notes.md with a stable note_key.
relations.construction_rule: C0/C1: Segment commercial_notes.md into keyed paragraphs; persist literal text without interpretive paraphrase.

relations.name: normalized_string_equal
relations.meaning: Two literal strings are identical after deterministic normalization (case fold, trim whitespace, strip trailing punctuation).
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must be derivable by applying the fixed normalization function to two source literals without semantic inference.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Assert when normalize(left) == normalize(right) for candidate string pairs generated from source literals.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate pairs from distinct name literals appearing on invoices, CRM accounts, registry legal names, and contract counterparty names.

relations.name: legal_form_name_variant
relations.meaning: Two names are exact legal-form variants of the same registered name under fixed suffix and punctuation rules (e.g. Ltd vs Limited).
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must be justified by applying the fixed legal-form normalization table to two source name literals, or by a commercial_note_entry that explicitly states sameness.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Assert when names match after legal-form canonicalization rules only; do not use fuzzy or visual similarity.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate unordered pairs among invoice billed names, CRM account names, registry legal names, and contract counterparty names that share a common stem after stripping known legal suffixes.

relations.name: contract_clause_category
relations.meaning: Whether a contract section's language satisfies a named term category drawn from an explicit closed vocabulary.
relations.grounding_contract: Each ACCEPT tuple must cite the contract_section_clause text and quote or pointer supporting the category match; ambiguous text yields ambiguous disposition only.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: For each contract section and each category in the closed vocabulary, resolve whether the clause text satisfies that category.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cross product of contract_section_clause tuples with categories: for A — change_of_control_consent, change_of_control_termination, assignment_consent_or_notice, assignment_affiliate_exception, assignment_competitor_prohibition; for C — exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term; also evaluate term_clause against auto_renewal and rolling_term.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the grounded clause language satisfies the named category under the category definition.

relations.name: invoice_is_open
relations.meaning: Whether an invoice's billing status is open as mechanically determined from invoice_status.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs must be invoice_status; result grounded via DERIVATION to that relation.
relations.construction_rule: C4: is_open = true when invoice_status.status = 'open', else false.

relations.name: contract_expired_by_stated_date
relations.meaning: Whether a contract has passed an explicit expiry date stated in the contract document relative to the data-room as-of context.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs must be contract_expiry_date; when no expiry date tuple exists, no row is emitted (open world on negation).
relations.construction_rule: C4: expired = true when contract_expiry_date is present and before the evaluation reference date; omit tuple when expiry_date absent.

relations.name: contract_has_acquisition_relevant_term
relations.meaning: Whether any contract section is classified present under at least one acquisition-relevance category.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs must be contract_clause_category filtered to acquisition categories with disposition present.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Emit has_term=true only when any acquisition category has disposition present on any section; omit tuple when no present classification (kernel cannot persist closed-world false).

relations.name: contract_has_qualifying_obligation
relations.meaning: Whether a contract carries a qualifying obligation kind (exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term) per grounded clause classification.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs must be contract_clause_category for obligation_kind vocabulary with disposition present.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Emit present=true rows only for obligation_kind values with disposition present on any section or term_clause; omit absent kinds (no closed-world negation).

relations.name: invoice_contract_association
relations.meaning: Whether an invoice can be confidently linked to a governing contract under the purpose A association threshold.
relations.grounding_contract: Asserted disposition must cite invoice billed name, contract counterparty, commercial notes, and any B identity links used; unresolved when confidence bar not met.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: For candidate invoice–contract pairs, resolve asserted vs unresolved; never infer association from absence of evidence.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Pairs where billed name matches contract counterparty via normalized_string_equal or legal_form_name_variant, or commercial_note_entry explicitly links invoice customer to contract; include all invoices with any acquisition-relevant contract candidate.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether invoice billed name and contract counterparty can be confidently treated as the same commercial relationship for association.

relations.name: identity_link_epistemic
relations.meaning: Epistemic status of whether two cross-system identifiers denote the same legal counterparty, a distinct party, or remain unresolved under purpose B policies.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must use identifier forms crm:, billing:, registry:, contract:; SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require positive evidence; default is UNRESOLVED.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: Resolve required connectivity links per commercially relevant CRM–billing–contract–registry chains.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each CRM account in scope, emit links among crm:, billing:<billed_name>, contract:<id>, and registry:<company_number> candidates needed for end-to-end connectivity; include pairs suggested by legal_form_name_variant, normalized_string_equal, and commercial_note_entry.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether two records denote the same legal entity, are positively distinct, or lack sufficient evidence.

relations.name: purpose_a_contract_active
relations.meaning: Whether a contract counts as active for purpose A (an expired statement of work is not active).
relations.grounding_contract: Must ground to contract_expiry_date, contract_expired_by_stated_date, and contract document type; expired SOW yields active=false.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: Apply purpose A active-contract policy using grounded expiry facts; do not treat silence on renewal as expiry.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether a contract without explicit expiry should be treated as active for purpose A.

relations.name: purpose_c_contract_active
relations.meaning: Whether a contract counts as active for purpose C commercial-dependency analysis (expired contracts do not create current dependency).
relations.grounding_contract: Must ground to contract_expiry_date and contract_expired_by_stated_date; expired contracts yield active=false.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: Apply purpose C active-contract policy using grounded expiry facts.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether a continuing-term contract without explicit expiry is active for dependency purposes.

relations.name: purpose_a_qualifying_invoice
relations.meaning: An invoice that qualifies for purpose A output: associated with a counterparty whose active contract has acquisition-relevant terms, with explicit association status.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs: invoice attributes, invoice_contract_association, purpose_a_contract_active, contract_has_acquisition_relevant_term, contract_identifier.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Include invoice when linked contract is purpose-A-active and has acquisition-relevant term; emit association from invoice_contract_association or unresolved when link missing.

relations.name: purpose_b_required_link
relations.meaning: A connectivity link required for purpose B output between two cross-system identifiers with epistemic status.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs must be identity_link_epistemic restricted to the required link candidate set.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Project identity_link_epistemic tuples for required connectivity pairs; sort by left then right for output.

relations.name: current_commercial_relationship
relations.meaning: Whether a counterparty has a current commercial relationship under purpose C rules (open invoice or active auto-renewing/rolling contract).
relations.grounding_contract: Must ground to invoice_is_open linked via identity_link_epistemic, or purpose_c_contract_active combined with contract_has_qualifying_obligation for auto_renewal/rolling_term.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: Evaluate conjunct (1) of the dependency definition per counterparty–contract pair.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Counterparty identifiers from purpose B forms crossed with contracts that have open invoices or rolling/auto-renewal term classifications.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether identity joins sufficient to attribute an open invoice or active continuing contract to the counterparty identifier.

relations.name: purpose_c_dependency_row
relations.meaning: A purpose C output row marking a counterparty–contract pair as commercially dependent or unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs: current_commercial_relationship, purpose_c_contract_active, contract_has_qualifying_obligation, identity_link_epistemic, invoice_is_open.
relations.construction_rule: C4: status=dependent when both dependency conjuncts hold with resolvable identity; status=unresolved when identity blocks evaluation; omit expired one-off paid historical cases.

relations.name: purpose_c_open_invoice_for_dependency
relations.meaning: An open invoice attributed to a counterparty–contract pair for purpose C output evidence.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs: invoice_is_open, invoice_contract_association or identity-linked billing identifier, contract_identifier.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Emit open invoice_ids linked to the dependency row when identity and association support attribution.

relations.name: purpose_c_obligation_kind_for_dependency
relations.meaning: A qualifying obligation kind present on a contract for purpose C output, drawn only from exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs: contract_has_qualifying_obligation and contract_identifier.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Project present obligation kinds per contract_id for inclusion in sorted obligation_kinds lists.
